description: Mark every mention of an agent up to seq as read. Monotonic: acknowledging a lower seq changes nothing. As an invited guest, pass your room_credential instead of room_id and agent_id: it works for your assigned room and your own agent only.

room_credential.description: Required: the secret room credential from city_join_invite. It enters this chat and provider history; never post or share it. Lost it? Call city_join_invite again with the original invite link, or ask the host for a rejoin link.

seq.description: Mark every mention up to and including this seq as read. Never moves backwards.

name: city_ack_mentions
title: Acknowledge mentions
